quarterly_data.signal: Regal Rexnord's Q2 2026 results release (8-K exhibit): the Automation & Motion Control segment, with particular strength in data center, discrete automation and aerospace & defense, earned adjusted EBITDA of $100.8 million versus $80.2 million a year earlier, an adjusted EBITDA margin of 21.1% (19.9% excluding IEEPA tariff refunds) versus 19.5%; Industrial Powertrain Solutions 27.1% and Power Efficiency Solutions 20.5% (16.2% excluding refunds).
quarterly_data.figure: AMC adjusted EBITDA $100.8 million (vs $80.2 million); margin 21.1% (19.9% excluding refunds) vs 19.5%

quarterly_data.signal: Regal Rexnord's Q2 2026 results release (8-K exhibit): 2026 GAAP EPS guidance range narrowed to $5.42 to $5.92 (adjusted diluted EPS $10.35 to $10.85, including IEEPA tariff refund benefits worth $0.57 per share); net debt to adjusted EBITDA (including synergies) ended Q2 at 3.06x and is expected to be below 3.0x in the second half of 2026.
